description: Interface definition for a cell read filter in PhpSpreadsheet library, declaring a method to determine if a cell should be read based on its address, row, and worksheet name.

classes.name: IReadFilter
classes.description: Interface that defines a method to filter cells during spreadsheet reading based on cell address and worksheet context.

methods.name: readCell
methods.description: Method to decide whether a specific cell identified by column address, row, and optional worksheet name should be read.
